reads.sell: A crisp, dry Pinot Grigio from the foothills of the Alps, pear, green apple and white peach with a clean, stony finish. Light and refreshing, it suits antipasti, trout or a seafood risotto.

why.grape: Near neutral pear and apple, a faint bitter almond grip on the finish and a light, dry frame with no oak and no aromatic lift read as Italian Pinot Grigio.
why.climate: Crisp acidity, moderate alcohol and fruit between tart and just ripe say a cool continental site, with cold nights off the Alps.
